newsitem.title: GERMANY: German bourse to transfer electronic bond trade.
newsitem.headline: German bourse to transfer electronic bond trade.

text.p: The German bourse operating company Deutsche Boerse AG said on Friday that it will transfer electronic bond trade from the IBIS system onto the IBIS-R electronic system on Monday.
The transfer onto the IBIS-R system "will allow the use of the expanded functionality of the IBIS-R system for debt trade," Deutsche Boerse said in a statement.

On top of mortgage bonds and municipal bonds already traded on IBIS-R, the system will trade Bunds and Bobls, bonds and loans on individual German states, and bonds and loans on special government assets.
The bourse said that only shares and options would now be traded on the IBIS systems.
